results.title: Senate Democrats to deploy more than 100 election observers for midterms (Erum Salam/MS NOW)
results.description: Erum Salam / MS NOW: Senate Democrats to deploy more than 100 election observers for midterms — The deployment of Senate staffers comes amid the Trump administration's push to reshape election rules, including efforts to remove people it deems ineligible from voter rolls and restrict mail-in and absentee voting.

results.title: Bronson will keep campaigning despite Trump’s call to drop out
results.description: Trump accuses Dave Bronson of going back on a promise to drop out of the race. Bronson says there was almost a deal to unite the field behind Wilson, but it fell through.

results.title: Breaking News Live Updates: Delhi Police detains Ankita Bhandari's parents, Congress leaders amid protest at India Gate
results.description: Breaking News Live Updates: Delhi Police on Thursday detained Ankita Bhandari's parents and several opposition leaders during a sit-in protest at India Gate, with Congress leaders accusing the police of manhandling demonstrators and demanding justice in the case.

results.title: NYC carriage horses suffer from lack of care and oversight, new report shows
results.description: Our new report adds to the urgency to pass a ban on NYC carriage horses.
